name: Inquisitor Jnasu
body:
Among the Daitya, there are a few individuals that feel the higher calling to maintain the laws, be it their own, other people’s, or even the world’s. These individuals are called jnasu, inquisitors who derive their powers not from deities, but from the law itself.

Alignment: A jnasu must always be within one step of lawful neutral (LG, LN, LE or TN (true neutral)). This modifies alignment.

Domain: A jnasu must select one of the following domains or subdomains: Akasha, Essence, Inevitable, Judgement, Law, Legislation. A jnasu also has the option to select he unique brand inquisition, detailed below. This modifies domain.

Brand Inquisition

You are adept at chastising those that break the law, able to brand them with powerful, special veils.

Deities: Any non-chaotic

Granted Powers: Brandweaving: Each day, you can brandweave a veil with the [brand] descriptor (as the volur class feature), using your Wisdom modifier instead of your Charisma modifier.

Brandbinding: Whenever you shape your brand veil, you can also bind it to any chakra you have access to for greater effects.

Note-A jnasu that gains the Judgment subdomain gains an alternate version of the domain’s granted power that functions as follows:

Chastisement (Su)

As a standard action, you can empower one of your veils against a creature that damaged you since your last turn. The veil is treated as having 1 additional point of essence invested in it the next time you attack such a creature with it or use one of its effects against them. This virtual essence is only used to determine the effect of the veil against the targeted creature. Area of effect veil effects cannot be used in conjunction with this ability, but other effects that target multiple creatures may be. You can use this ability a number of times per day equal to 3 + your Wisdom modifier.

Veilweaving

A jnasu learns to shape the magical power known as akasha into powerful veils, which are drawn from the Volur veil list. J?nasu also add all veils from the Boatman’s Ensemble veil set, and all veils with the lawful descriptor to their veil list. This does not allow them to gain veils associated with esoteric chakras, nor veils with special subtype (e.g. title or emblem). They know and can shape any veil from this list. The DC for a saving throw against a veil’s abilities is 10 + the number of points of essence invested in the veil + the jnasu’s Wisdom modifier. They can only shape a certain number of veils per day. They can shape 1 veil at 1st level, and gain the ability to shape 1 additional veil each day at 3rd, 6th, 9th, 12th, 15th, and 18th level. Veils are constructs of pure magic and are suppressed while in the area of an antimagic field or similar phenomena.

At 1st level the jnasu also gains access to their own personal pool of essence, which can be invested into veils and other receptacles to increase their power. The jnasu gains 1 point of essence at each class level. The jnasu’s character level determines the maximum quantity of essence they can invest in any single veil. As a swift action, they can reallocate their essence investments into their veils every round. A jnasu must have a good night’s rest and must meditate for one hour to prepare her veils for the day. This replaces orisons and spellcasting.

Chakra Binds

At 3rd level and every three levels thereafter, the jnasu gains the ability to bind veils directly to their chakra, unlocking potent new abilities. At 3rd level, the jnasu gains access to a low chakra bind; each day when they shape their veils, they can choose whether they wish to bind veils to the Feet or Hands slot. At 6th level, they additionally can choose between the Head slot, and can choose two low chakra binds rather than one.

At 9th level, the jnasu gains access to a middle chakra bind; each day when they shape their veils, they can choose whether they wish to bind veils to the Wrists or Shoulders slots. At 12th level, they additionally can choose between the Headband slot, and choose two middle chakra binds rather than one.

At 15th level, the jnasu gains access to a high chakra bind; each day when they shape their veils, they can choose whether they wish to bind veils to the Neck or Belt slots. At 18th level, they get both high chakra binds.

At 20th level, the jnasu gains access to a higher chakra bind; each day when they shape their veils, they can choose whether they wish to bind veils to the Body or Chest slots.
